summary: Batch certification of three exploration maps (explorations/cause-of-quality-more-such.toml, efficient-cause-prior.toml, nothing-moves-except-in-act.toml). (1) The Metaphysics II.1 'cause of a quality is more such' premise from six open reception/limitation premises; the map's single 'unlimited by that recipient' step needed both directions of reception<->limitation relativized to the limiter z, plus the effect's reception of what is caused in it. It avoids q.4 a.2 preexistence, so no cycle with PERFECTION-PREEXISTENCE-FROM-CAUSAL-TRANSFER. (2) The secunda via premises 'efficient cause is prior' and 'nothing prior to itself' from a dependence analysis of priority, split into its sufficient and necessary directions so each derivation uses the weakest one; plus two side results from dependence alone: nothing is its own efficient cause (second route bypassing priority) and no mutual efficient causation. (3) The prima via 'moves only as in act' by cases on mover = moved: a distinct mover causes, so is more such, so is in act; a self-mover moves by a distinct part, which is in act by the first case, and the whole is in act through its part. This answers the self-mover gap of ATTEMPT-REJECTED-DERIVATION-LEADS-20261107 without STMT-NO-MOVER-MOVES-ITSELF-IN-ITS-RESPECT (itself derived from the target). Controls: 21 omission models from scripts/countermodel.py (Fin carriers renamed to Bool/Unit so decide is axiom-free), plus one hand-written joint witness with nonempty causing, moving, self-moving and efficient-causing relations; excluded middle has no omission model within the bounds. Rejected edges are recorded in ATTEMPT-CAUSAL-MAPS-BATCH1-REJECTED-EDGES.
blocker: Every new premise is open. Supported (claim bears on it, gap noted): cause has what it gives (q.4 a.2, scoped to causes of being), received perfection is limited (q.7 a.1-2), limitation only through reception (q.7 a.1, which its claim restricts to esse: the generalization is in tension with that restriction), effect depends on its efficient cause (q.44 a.1 ad 2), self-mover moves by a distinct part (Physics VIII.4; VIII.5 unpinned). Bare analyst premises: caused perfection is had; perfection caused in another is received in it; cause's perfection not received in its effect; unlimited possession exceeds limited; efficient cause not dependent on effect; both directions of priority as nonmutual dependence; mover causes what it moves to (crosses DISAMB-CAUSE as an explicit bridge); whole in act through its part (contestable for wholes that are so only in a part).
